seller_questions: What is the VIN, and is the title clean and in your name? Can you send a photo of the title with personal details masked?
Will you provide a California smog certificate under 90 days old, with the printout showing emissions readings, before sale?
Do you have dated receipts for timing chain, guide rail or tensioner work? If so, at what date and mileage?
What caused the wet patches under the front and rear of the car in the photos? Was it washed, or does it drip oil, ATF or coolant when parked?
Can you send photos of the underside (sills, jacking points, floor pans) and of the trunk floor with the spare tire removed?
Have the carpets ever been pulled? Is there any rust or water under them or in the spare-tire well?
Can you send a cold-start video from fully cold, showing the exhaust for the first minute and the idle after warm-up?
Is the soft top included? What condition are the top and frame in?
What are the DOT date codes on all four tires?
Will you allow a pre-purchase inspection at an independent Mercedes shop of my choice, including a compression test?
How long have you owned the car, and do you have any service records from you or the previous owner?
Does the temperature gauge stay steady in traffic, and does the A/C work?
ppi_focus: Lift inspection of sills, four jacking points, front and rear floor pans (carpets lifted behind the seats) and trunk floor/spare well
Lower windshield frame and A-pillar bases, especially the area showing damaged trim in the photos
Source of any drips: rear main seal, oil pan, transmission, vacuum modulator (ATF in the intake), radiator and water pump
Valve covers off: timing chain guide rails, tensioner, chain stretch, and cam lobe/rocker wear
Compression test on all eight cylinders plus a cold-start smoke check for valve stem seals
CIS baseline: fuel pressure, warm-up regulator, cold-start valve, vacuum leaks, and a pre-smog sniff test with emissions hardware present
Transmission fluid colour and smell, shift quality, and engagement delay
Driveshaft flex discs, center bearing, engine/transmission mounts and front-end ball joints/idler arm
Cooling system: radiator, fan clutch, hoses, and gauge stability on an extended idle
Tire date codes and brake hoses/calipers
what_would_change_verdict: Up: a clean lift inspection showing solid floors and sills, plus a passing current smog certificate supplied by the seller.
Up: dated receipts for timing chain guides and CIS work, and a healthy compression test.
Down: rust at the A-pillar base, floors or jacking points, or ATF/oil confirmed as the source of the pavement stains.
Down: seller declines to provide the VIN, a smog certificate or PPI access.
evidence.mission_note: This conflicts with the enthusiast-bridge brief. It is an automatic-only R107 cruiser with no records, not a manual driver's car. At best it is a cheap top-down toy, and it does not win decisively on reliability, condition or resale to qualify as a pragmatic bridge.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes little beyond a 1979 450SL (confirmed by the trunk badge) with its hardtop fitted, an automatic transmission, and an odometer reading of 127,874 against a stated 126,000. There is no VIN, title statement, service record, smog certificate or underbody photo. The only condition evidence is the seller's 'runs perfect very well taken care of'. The photos show wear that undercuts that claim: a torn driver bolster, cracked leather, stained carpets, a sagging headliner and perished weatherstrip. They also show apparent damaged trim at a lower A-pillar/windshield-frame area, a known cowl-leak rust zone. Dark wet patches under the front and rear of the car may be wash water or fluid; this is unresolved. Every model-critical item is missing: underbody rust photos, timing chain receipts, a CA smog certificate, compression data and a cold-start video. The asking price sits in the profile's rough-example band, and the car is close enough to Carmel for an easy in-person PPI.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller for the VIN, title status and a current smog certificate, and ask about the wet patches under the car and whether a local independent PPI with a lift inspection is allowed.
